decisions.conflict: V8 package and validators still identify V7
decisions.resolution: All V9 runtime metadata and contracts use 9.0.0; validators compare machine version fields rather than fixed prose.

decisions.conflict: Proportional R0/R1/R2 recovery versus mandatory startup full read
decisions.resolution: R0/R1/R2 conditions in state-contract.json are authoritative; full recovery only occurs under R2 conditions.

decisions.conflict: Sole controller versus manuscript execution gates claiming first entry
decisions.resolution: SKILL.md is sole controller; rule 20 content is an acceptance crosscheck with its first-entry claim retired.

decisions.conflict: SKILL, rule 18 and two schemas define incompatible receipts
decisions.resolution: One discriminated receipt.schema.json owns start, end and skill-change receipts.

decisions.conflict: Single project stage is used for questions, shared data and artifacts
decisions.resolution: Typed state machines distinguish question, shared_data, artifact and project components.

decisions.conflict: Data audit is assigned both S2 and S3
decisions.resolution: Data uses D0-D3: audit D0-D1, treatment D1-D2, freeze D2-D3; question stages reference evidence without owning data state.

decisions.conflict: Model comparison is routed only to S4/S5 while controller assigns it to S3
decisions.resolution: RT-MODEL-COMPARE operates at S2/S3; specification and implementation have distinct routes.

decisions.conflict: R0 is required to emit a recovery manifest
decisions.resolution: R0 returns an assessment in memory or response; it creates no manifest file.

decisions.conflict: Closure and maintenance catchalls make all rules appear reachable
decisions.resolution: V9 has no wildcard modules and excludes catchalls from reachability by contract.

decisions.conflict: Receipt routed_rules are not checked against registry
decisions.resolution: V9 receipt validation resolves the route and requires exact module equality.

decisions.conflict: Substantive analysis is forced into project artifacts even without write authorization
decisions.resolution: Execution modes separate advisory/project read-only from authorized mutation; read-only creates no files.

decisions.conflict: Decision schema forces keep_current and necessary in greenfield work
decisions.resolution: Decisions distinguish new_design, change_existing and not_applicable.

decisions.conflict: Verification labels V1-V4 collide with release versions
decisions.resolution: Verification levels are E1_IMPLEMENTATION through E4_REALITY.

decisions.conflict: Compound labels mix normative strength and applicability
decisions.resolution: Machine registry uses independent strength and trigger fields; imported compound labels remain lineage annotations only.

decisions.conflict: Project bootstrap eagerly creates a full directory and placeholder surface
decisions.resolution: Only .modeling/state.json is created at explicit initialization; all other artifacts require a consumer and authorization.

decisions.conflict: Skill maintenance route can silently modify itself and self-certify
decisions.resolution: Explicit skill intent, risk classification, impact analysis, tests, rollback and fresh-invocation validation are required.
